title: CALIBRATION_ASSIGNMENT_V1
description: JSON schema for Observe.ai bulk S3 export of calibration assignment records. Each file is gzip-compressed JSON (CALIBRATION_ASSIGNMENT_V1_<timestamp>.json.gz). Each record is one JSON object.

_id.description: Unique identifier for this record (source system primary key).

assignment_configuration_id.description: Identifier of the parent assignment configuration.

start_time.description: UTC timestamp when the record/session started.

end_time.description: UTC timestamp when the record/session ended.

meeting_id.description: Observe.ai interaction (meeting) identifier this record relates to.

agent_id.description: Observe.ai user identifier for the agent.

evaluator_id.description: Observe.ai user identifier for the evaluator.

created_by_user_id.description: Identifier of the user who created the assignment.

assignment_progress.description: Overall completion progress of the assignment (0-1 or %).

matchScore.description: Percentage match for this question between evaluator and final calibration (0-100).

scoreVariance.description: Score variance for this question between evaluator and final calibration.

isQuestionAligned.description: Alignment indicator for the question (1 aligned, 0 not aligned; null for non-scorable question types).

evaluation_template_id.description: Identifier of the evaluation template used for this assignment.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the record was created.

modified_at.description: UTC timestamp when the record was last modified.

final_evaluation_id.description: Identifier of the evaluation selected as the final calibrated evaluation.

final_evaluation_submitted_at.description: UTC timestamp when the final calibrated evaluation was submitted.

finalCalibrationComment.description: Final calibrator's comment for this question.

calibration_evaluation_comment.description: Comments captured during the calibration session.

evaluator_calibration_score.description: Calibration score submitted by the evaluator.

evaluator_score_variance.description: Score variance between the evaluator and the final calibrated score.

final_calibrator_id.description: Identifier of the user who finalized the calibration.

aligned_questions_count.description: Number of questions aligned between evaluator and final calibration.

scorable_questions_count.description: Number of scorable questions in the template.

alignment_percentage.description: Percentage of questions aligned between evaluator and final calibration.

third_party_id.description: External/third-party identifier associated with this calibration record.
